crossRefs.note: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say…
Sheol, the barren womb; the earth that is not satisfied with water; and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough.’
Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. An arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol, and he…
Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced…
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…
He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he who loves abundance, with increase: this also is vanity.
When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on…
All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing…
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s…

translations.web: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
translations.bsb: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
translations.kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
translations.asv: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; And the eyes of man are never satisfied.
